faqs.q: Sea freight or air freight — which should I use?
faqs.a: Sea freight is the economical choice for large or heavy consignments and takes weeks; air freight suits urgent, small or high-value cargo and takes days. Tell us what you are shipping and when you need it, and we will quote the option that fits — sometimes both.

faqs.q: My cargo does not fill a container. Can you still ship it?
faqs.a: Yes. Give us the volume (cubic metres) and weight and we will advise between a full container (FCL) and shared-container (LCL) space, with the costs of each.

faqs.q: What do you need from me to quote?
faqs.a: Origin and destination, a description of the goods, weight and volume or container size, who is paying the freight (the Incoterm, if you know it), and the date the cargo is ready. A photo of the supplier's packing list is usually enough to start.

faqs.q: Can I follow my shipment?
faqs.a: Yes. You get updates at each stage — booked, departed, arrived, cleared, out for delivery — by WhatsApp or e-mail, and one person to call throughout.

faqs.q: Where do you deliver?
faqs.a: Daily within Tema and Accra, to every region of Ghana, and across the border to neighbouring countries. Quote requests outside Greater Accra get a fixed round-trip price.

faqs.q: What documents do I need to clear goods at Tema Port?
faqs.a: The bill of lading (or airway bill for air cargo), the commercial invoice, the packing list, your TIN / Ghana Card details, and any permit the goods require (for example FDA or Ghana Standards Authority for regulated items). Send us scans first — we check the set before anything is lodged, which is where most delays are avoided.

faqs.q: How long does customs clearing take?
faqs.a: With complete documents and duties paid promptly, most consignments are released within 2–5 working days of arrival. Examinations, missing paperwork or late payment add time. We tell you where the shipment is at each step, so there are no surprises.

faqs.q: How is import duty calculated?
faqs.a: On the customs value of the goods (cost, insurance and freight) and their tariff classification. Import duty, VAT and the statutory levies are then applied, plus port and handling charges. We give you an itemised estimate before you commit, and the final figures come straight from the customs assessment.

faqs.q: Can you clear a vehicle or personal effects?
faqs.a: Yes. Vehicle duty depends on the year, engine size and value, and older vehicles attract additional penalties, so send us the details before you ship. For personal effects we need the packing list and your travel/ID documents.

faqs.q: Do I need to come to Tema myself?
faqs.a: No. With a signed authorisation and copies of your documents we handle the port, the declaration and the release; you only pay the duties and fees. We can then truck the goods to your door or hold them in our warehouse.

faqs.q: Where is the warehouse?
faqs.a: In Community 4, Tema, near Valco Roundabout — minutes from Tema Port, so cleared cargo can go straight into storage instead of running up port charges.

faqs.q: Is there a minimum storage period?
faqs.a: No. Some clients store goods for a few days after clearing, others for a whole season. Storage is priced on the space you take and the time you keep it — tell us the quantity and duration and we will quote.

faqs.q: How are my goods looked after?
faqs.a: Everything is checked and recorded on arrival, stored in an organised location and dispatched only on your instruction, with stock records you can request at any time.

faqs.q: Can you deliver from storage?
faqs.a: Yes. Combined storage-and-delivery is one of our most common arrangements: goods go out in the quantities you need, when you need them, on our own trucks.
